Manifest URL for this Health Link

element.short: Decryption key for processing files returned in the manifest. 43 characters, consisting of 32 random bytes base64urlencoded.
element.definition: Decryption key for processing files returned in the manifest. 43 characters, consisting of 32 random bytes base64urlencoded.

element.short: Optional. Number representing expiration time in Epoch seconds, as a hint to help the Health Link Receiving Application determine if this QR is stale. (Note: epoch times should be parsed into 64-bit numeric types.)
element.definition: Optional. Number representing expiration time in Epoch seconds, as a hint to help the Health Link Receiving Application determine if this QR is stale. (Note: epoch times should be parsed into 64-bit numeric types.)

element.short: Optional. String no longer than 80 characters that provides a short description of the data behind the Health Link.
element.definition: Optional. String no longer than 80 characters that provides a short description of the data behind the Health Link.

element.short: Optional. Integer representing the Health Links protocol version this Health Link conforms to. MAY be omitted when the default value (1) applies.
element.definition: Optional. Integer representing the Health Links protocol version this Health Link conforms to. MAY be omitted when the default value (1) applies.

element.short: Classifying type code to distinguish different types of health links.  If not present then the Health Link is a SMART Health Link.
element.definition: Classifying type code to distinguish different types of health links.  If not present then the Health Link is a SMART Health Link.
